title: Fixed-array result stores
summary: Executes standard length and payload stores and reconstructs singleton or pair UInt64 array representations from their named result stores.
premises: Frame getters for the result root and stored value
Current-memory bounds for the selected result words
A continuation from the named length or payload store
For representation theorems, complete 32-bit and current-memory fit for the result array
result: The emitted result store reaches an arbitrary continuation, or the named result memory satisfies the singleton or pair UInt64 array representation.
